latestTerminalSummary:
3 findings. Read-only review done, no edits. Snapshot `learning/.cache/review-r1`, manifest SHA matches.

**Medium — `solid` wrong for moving patterns**
`learning/native/src/observation.rs:131`: `solid: rect.sh == PicoFixed::from_int(2)`.
For `pattern.pattern_type == 1`, core draws rect filled at any `sh` (`crates/dodge-core/src/snapshot.rs:1046` else → `rect_fill`) and kills player at any `sh` (`crates/dodge-core/src/game.rs:959`).
Rects reset `shown: true, sh: 0` (`crates/dodge-core/src/patterns.rs:83`, `apply_defaults` `:731`). `sh` grows `0.02 * freeze_rate` per frame (`game.rs:1588`, `:1723`) → first ~100 frames of every moving pattern read `solid=false` while filled and lethal.
`pattern_type` not exported (`observation.rs:27`, `python.rs:210`) → consumer cannot correct.
Trigger: any episode where `with_type(1)` pattern activates (`patterns.rs:189+`).
Consequence: teacher label says lethal block not solid → learns to stand in it. No current consumer (`policies.py:92` ignores it); no test asserts `solid`.
Fix: `solid: pattern.pattern_type == 1 || rect.sh == PicoFixed::from_int(2)`. Test: type1 rect at `sh < 2` → `true`; type0 at `sh < 2` → `false`.

**Low — visibility window clamps world coords, not screen coords**
`learning/native/src/observation.rs:68-73`: `min_x = (camera_x + clip_x).max(0)`, `max_x = (camera_x + clip_x + clip_width - 1).min(127)`.
Renderer plots `world - camera` clipped to screen `[0,128)` (`snapshot.rs:287-300`). True window: `[camera+clip_x, camera+clip_x+clip_w-1]`, no world `[0,127]` clamp.
`camera_offset` rounds half-up (`snapshot.rs:1222`, copy `observation.rs:169`). Shake `+0.07` on collision (`game.rs:993`, `:1064`, `:1469`), decays `×0.95` (`game.rs:1859`) → ~7 frames of offset ±1/±2.
Trigger: enemy spawned at `SPAWN_EDGE_FAR = 138` (`game.rs:15`) reaching `x = 128` with `camera_x = 1..2` → drawn at screen 126-127, excluded because `128 <= 127` fails. Left edge: enemy span `[-5,-1]` with `camera_x = -2`.
Consequence: student pixels show hazard, `train_only_state` drops it → distillation asymmetry. Direction is false negative only; window never wider than true window.
Fix: clamp in screen space, then add camera. Test: snapshot with `camera_x` rounding to 2 and enemy at `x = 128.0` → present in `enemies`.

**Low — provenance stale in git worktrees**
`learning/native/build.rs:4`: `cargo:rerun-if-changed=../../.git`. In a worktree `.git` is a file; git never rewrites it on commit. Build script runs once, bakes `git rev-parse HEAD` (`build.rs:7`) and `git diff --quiet HEAD` (`build.rs:15`) into `DODGE_GAME_REVISION`/`DODGE_CORE_DIRTY`, cached by cargo (`python.rs:147-148`).
Trigger: commit touching only `.git/worktrees/<name>/HEAD` → watched paths unchanged → no rerun → previous revision, stale `core_source_dirty`.
Consequence: `evaluate.py:143` copies provenance verbatim into receipts → misattributed build.
Fix: emit `rerun-if-changed` for `git -C ../.. rev-parse --git-path HEAD` and `--git-path index`. Test: build, commit, rebuild, assert `provenance["game_revision"] == new HEAD`.

Clean, checked, no finding: startup frame 13 `mode_before == TransitionToGame` → `survival_frames == 0` at reset, matches `learning/README.md:51`; discount/bootstrap `env.rs:226-243` matches `README.md:49`; death-over-cap `env.rs:240` + test `:457`; repeat reward/event accumulation `env.rs:210-236`; pattern-end counter `env.rs:218-223` (end→start same frame impossible); wire version LE at bytes `4..8` (`python.rs:60`); `PyList` action_masks fix + integration test; `score` `ceil` matches renderer `snapshot.rs:961`; warnings gate `observation.rs:134` matches renderer `snapshot.rs:1046`; no `unwrap`/`unsafe`/panic in non-test `learning/native/src`; `unique_seeds` 0/1 alias and 1000 cap; `PixelHistory` `+1` id rule; `distillation_loss` KL direction; `resolve_device` fallback rule; evaluate guards `evaluate.py:90,94,106-109`.

Rejected as pre-existing: base `d7ad9512` equals HEAD; only `learning/`, `docs/`, root `Cargo.toml`/`README.md`/`.gitignore` differ, so all core-crate quirks out of scope.

Review complete. Next step: fix or reject the three above.
